latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Video Editing AI Image skill.
- Convert JPG, PNG, MP4, and MOV files (up to 200MB) into animated 1080p MP4 video clips using cloud GPUs.
- Supports social media creators and marketers in turning static images into dynamic video content.
- Enables quick uploads, customization with transitions, background music, and text overlays.
- Intuitive workflows: upload files, describe the desired video, and receive the result in about 30–60 seconds.
